svg.aria-label: Same score, very different bill: the four agent systems of gpt-6.1-sol complete 27 to 29 of 36 tasks. Over all 36 tasks, the single-agent system takes 407 hours, 2 times the time of the decentralized system, and uses 17.1 billion input tokens; the hierarchical system 204 hours and 51.7 billion, 3 times the input tokens of the single-agent system; the decentralized system 199 hours and 45.3 billion; the adaptive system 258 hours and 27.0 billion
